decision.rationale: The homepage identifies the Stream and Riparian Research Laboratory at UBC Forestry and describes a collective research program and current projects. Although the named professor's education and CV appear, substantive laboratory research content establishes an institutional research site rather than a personal-only page. No Okanagan-exclusive mandate is stated.
